text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — intake gateways + feedback contracts for our first wave of design partners. Need recruitment criteria + feedback loop SLAs by EOD Wed. TL;DR: propose 3 intake gates (fit, legal, technical) and a 2-tier feedback contract (weekly async + biweekly sync). Thoughts?

AJ: I like 3 gates. Can we add a usage gate? e.g., expected trial usage >= 10 sessions/week to qualify.

Leo Chen: I can draft the screening form. Fields I’ll include: company, team size, primary use case, infra (cloud/on-prem), data sensitivity, production intent (yes/no), expected monthly tokens.

Samir Khan: @Maya can we quantify the SLAs? Suggestion: 72h response for critical issues, 7-day turnaround for prompt eval requests, and 48h for onboarding questions.

Irina Kovalenko: Also want to avoid overburdening seed-stage partners. Maybe offer an "opt-in" for weekly calls; small teams get async-only option.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Proposed scoring rule: fit_score = impact(1-5)+infra(1-5)+ops_maturity(1-5). Invite if `fit_score >= 9`. Legal gate = NDA signed (checkbox) + data-sharing allowed (yes/no). Technical gate = baseline capture possible (7d) + API access confirmed.

Leo Chen: Dropping a form skeleton shortly: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/ABC123 (placeholder). Will include a hidden numeric `fit_score` calc.

Samir Khan: For feedback contracts: shared Notion template + a prompt/regression checklist. Propose minimum prompt set = 20 examples (to make evals meaningful). Also require a baseline dataset capture before any A/B.

AJ: :thumbsup: 20 prompts is reasonable. Also propose a 30-day trial success window with 3 candidate success metrics: 1) user task completion increase >= 10%, 2) p95 latency < 200ms, or 3) cost/unit reduction > 15%. If none met, we iterate.

Irina Kovalenko: Instrumentation note — we need a small onboarding script to capture baseline request/response + tokens and latency. Add to onboarding checklist.

Maya Patel: Onboarding flow (draft): 1) baseline capture (7d) 2) model pin + canary 3) weekly async feedback digest 4) biweekly 30–45m sync 5) post-run retrospective. We'll add checkboxes for legal/tech fit.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: invite-form-template v0.1 to /releases on Fri 09:00 :rocket:

Leo Chen: CSV export columns I'll support: company, contact_name, contact_email, role, stage, use_case, fit_score, legal_ok, baseline_days, expected_sessions_wk, notes.

Samir Khan: One open question — who owns outreach? Growth or Solutions? @Maya please confirm.

Maya Patel: Split: Growth owns outreach & initial comms; Solutions owns onboarding + feedback synth and playbook ops.

AJ: Also recommend incentives: $500 credits + co-marketing feature for the top 3 partners based on impact.

Irina Kovalenko: +1 on incentives. Also need an "opt-out" feedback contract for regulated customers where raw prompts can't be shared — we can accept redacted examples and metrics only.

Maya Patel: Action items: Leo — form + CSV schema (due Tue). Samir — onboarding checklist + SLAs (due Wed). AJ — success metrics + incentive plan (due Wed). Irina — instrumentation plan + opt-out flow (due Tue). Can everyone commit?

Leo Chen: Yep, committed.

Samir Khan: I can take onboarding doc and SLAs.

AJ: I'll draft the metrics/incentives and sample annotation budget.

Irina Kovalenko: Will write instrumentation + opt-out doc.

Maya Patel: Great. I'll assemble the Notion hub and link the form once Leo publishes. Thanks all :heart:
